gen.title: Checking hash table definitions and behavior

cards.stem: What term describes two keys mapping to the same position?
cards.quote: There are many collision resolution schemes, but they may be divided into open addressing, chaining, and keeping one special overflow area.

cards.stem: How may hash table complexity behave if the table is big enough or grows?
cards.quote: Complexity depends on the hash function and collision resolution scheme, but may be constant (Θ(1)) if the table is big enough or grows.

cards.stem: Which of these is listed as one of the three main divisions for resolution schemes?
cards.quote: There are many collision resolution schemes, but they may be divided into open addressing, chaining, and keeping one special overflow area.
